note_frozen: the date this copy was made; the 4B configuration was not frozen by a user decision as the 0.8B one was

notes.state.heldout_fvu_own_units: the trainer's number: per-token-RMS-normalised, site-standardised units; first 4,096 tokens of each of four held-out splits, position 0 of a sequence included (training dropped position 0)
notes.mlp.heldout_*: measured by the original project on a held-out shard of the training capture that was deleted afterwards; position 0 included (training included it); these numbers cannot be recomputed from the published files
notes.mlp.tensor_bytes_sha256: sha256 of the tensor bytes only (the safetensors headers' metadata was rewritten once after training)
notes.original_sha256: sha256 of a config file before names of the original, unpublished project were removed for publication: in cfg.json the value of `kind` was replaced and four keys were removed (a configuration label, a source file path, a run label, and the md5 record of the original project's source files); in config.yaml the line naming the training data module was removed. Nothing else differs, and no tensor file was changed
